title: Witch in Arcane Study
description: A female alchemist or witch stands in a cluttered purple-hued mystical laboratory, reaching toward a shelf with one hand while the other hovers near a glowing blue crystal ball emitting purple smoke. The room is filled with potion bottles, an open spellbook on a wooden desk, a lit red candle, hanging herbs, and a large ornate painting of a skull with peacock feathers on the wall.
prompt: A detailed fantasy scene of a witch wearing a green headwrap and apron standing inside a purple mystical laboratory, reaching for a shelf while a glowing blue crystal ball swirls with purple smoke on the desk. Wooden cabinet filled with colorful potion bottles, large ornate red frame painting of a skull with peacock feathers on the wall, open spellbook, lit red candle, hanging herbs and lantern light, atmospheric and intricate detail.
